findings.title: Fix expired session inversion
findings.body: The expired session check is inverted, so active sessions are rejected while expired sessions pass.

findings.title: Stop logging sensitive token material
findings.body: This logs sensitive token material. Remove the token from logs or redact it before emitting telemetry.

findings.title: Fix cache capacity off-by-one
findings.body: The cache capacity check allows one extra entry before eviction.

findings.title: Avoid SQL interpolation
findings.body: Interpolating user input into SQL makes the query injectable. Use parameters.

findings.title: Use numeric sort
findings.body: Array sort without a comparator performs lexicographic ordering, not numeric sorting.

findings.title: Average the median pair
findings.body: For even-length input, median should average the middle pair instead of returning the lower element.

findings.title: Handle empty title words
findings.body: Empty words make word[0] undefined, so title casing can throw on repeated spaces.
